findings.summary: Parsed call names are type-checked but never matched against the request's offered functions, and mlx_lm's parser ignores tools, so a model can return a call to a function the caller never offered.
Only tool_choice none is handled; with required or a named function and no parsed call the response is an ordinary stop answer, completing a turn that violated its tool_choice.
Streaming requests bypass chat_completions, so a stream with tools and a required or named tool_choice succeeds as a plain text stream instead of being refused.
